<file name="PKGBUILD">
pkgname="ttf-victor-mono"
pkgdesc="Unoffical Victor Mono(TTF) AUR package"
pkgver=1.5.6
pkgrel=1
arch=(i686 x86_64 any)
url="https://rubjo.github.io/victor-mono-ttf/"
license=(OFL)
depends=()
makedepends=()
source=("ttf-victor-mono-1.5.6.zip"::"https://github.com/rubjo/victor-mono-ttf/archive/refs/tags/v1.5.6.tar.gz")

package() {
	cd "${srcdir}/victor-mono-ttf-${pkgver}"
	install -Dm644 *.ttf -t "${pkgdir}/usr/share/fonts/TTF/"
	install -Dm644 LICENSE -t "$pkgdir/usr/share/licenses/$pkgname"
}
</file>
